quests.desc: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First, it would be fantastic if you could move east. Next, make an attempt to go north. With that done, go to the north. If you can manage that, ensure that the hatch is open. And then, attempt to take a trip north. With that accomplished, move east. And then, make an attempt to venture north. Then, make an effort to travel west. Okay, and then, pick-up the cookie from the floor of the silent workshop. And if you do that, you're the winner!

objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, make an attempt to travel east. After that, go to the north. With that over with, go north. With that done, open the hatch. After that, take a trip north. If you can do that, make an effort to head east. Then, attempt to go north. Then, make an effort to go west. And then, lift the cookie from the floor of the silent workshop. Got that? Good!
